recipient.description: Destination address for an outbound conversation (E.164 for sms/imessage). Required for non-web.

use_case_id.title: Use Case Id
use_case_id.description: Channel-manager use case the outbound conversation is sent through. Required for non-web; channel-manager resolves the sender (FROM) from it (never caller-supplied). Must be owned by this workspace.

instruction.description: Optional context steering what the agent opens with on an outbound conversation.

force_new.title: Force New
force_new.description: Outbound thread-keyed channels (sms/imessage) only: close any existing ACTIVE conversation on the computed provider thread (recipient + use case) before dispatching, so the opener materializes a brand-new conversation instead of continuing the old thread. Rejected with 422 on channel=web — every web create already starts a new conversation, so force_new is meaningless there.

ChannelKind.title: ChannelKind
ChannelKind.description:
HSM execution channel type.

Determines how the HSM engine communicates with end users.
Each kind maps to one or more providers.
